name: Cortland County, NY
findings: Cortland County has 156 nonprofit organizations. 89 of them (57%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 78 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Cortland County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Cortland County list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 78 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 9 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do social and fraternal organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Hobby and sports organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 10 hobby and sports organizations here list membership, compared with about 3 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do hobby and sports organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?
